title: Major Headlines Transition Blurring Under Eye Blush Duo
descriptionHtml:
✓ Pressed Powder Formula✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Light Coverage✓ Matte Finish

What it is: An ultra-blurring blush topper—a finishing touch designed for a soft and seamless transition between concealer and blush.


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Papaya, Grapefruit, Pineapple Complex | Hollow Weight Silica and Light Reflecting Pigments: A boost of brightening fruit extracts with antioxidants.

- Flexible Gel-Like Copolymer: Blurring effects to smooth the appearance of skin.

- Hollow Weight Silica and Light Reflecting Pigments: Visibly fills in lines and diffuses light for added smoothness.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use after applying Liquid Brightening Transition Blush (sold separately) and concealer to your undereyes, followed by your normal blush.
-Swirl the fluffy side of the Dual-Ended Transition Blush Brush (sold separately) into one or both shades of the Transition Blurring Blush Duo (sold separately).
-Sweep the blurring powders on the undereyes and on the apples of the cheeks where your blush was applied.
Ingredients+
-Papaya, Grapefruit, Pineapple Complex | Hollow Weight Silica and Light Reflecting Pigments: A boost of brightening fruit extracts with antioxidants.
-Flexible Gel-Like Copolymer: Blurring effects to smooth the appearance of skin.
-Hollow Weight Silica and Light Reflecting Pigments: Visibly fills in lines and diffuses light for added smoothness.
